name: autonymous-me
description: Autonymous.me — self-sovereign identity hApp on Holochain 0.6 (zomes, wallet UI, verifier SDK, REST API)

scripts.network: hc sandbox clean && npm run build:happ && UI_PORT=$(get-port) concurrently "npm run start --workspace ui" "npm run launch:happ"
scripts.test: npm run build:zomes && npm run test --workspace api && npm run test --workspace sdk
scripts.package: npm run build:happ && npm run build --workspace ui && hc web-app pack . --output autonymous-me.webhapp
scripts.build:happ: npm run build:zomes && npm run copy-coordinator-wasms && hc dna pack dnas/core/ --output dnas/core/core.dna && hc app pack . --output autonymous-me.happ
